stats.text:
As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can do one of the following.

***Sleight of Hand.*** Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with {ref:equipment/thieves-tools} or to pick a pocket.

***Use an Object.*** Take the {ref:glossary/utilize} action, or take the {ref:glossary/magic} action to use a magic item that requires that action.
